concepts.prompt: Create a single exceptionally crafted macOS application icon for Kuizer, a developer disk cleanup app. Direction name: Glasswork. Subject: a bold lowercase k formed from three precise thick optical glass pieces: vertical rounded stem and two diagonal arms with a clear readable K silhouette. Pearl-white ceramic rounded-square tile, nested polished clear-glass rim, subtly iridescent edges, actual dimensional bevels, softly tinted sea-glass mint and icy cyan K with small warm amber refractions. Sophisticated industrial design, precise rounded corners, physically plausible refractions, fine satin microtexture, studio product lighting from upper left, realistic contact shadows. Front view with very slight dimensional perspective, entirely centered, entire icon visible with 12 percent transparent margin. Icon fills 76 percent canvas. 1024x1024 square output. No text, no letters except the K shape itself, no watermark, no scenery or supporting objects. The reference images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: borrow their extraordinary material quality and detailed rendering, do not copy their symbols or composition. This is a brand new logo idea. Isolated on a genuinely transparent background.

Create one exceptionally crafted macOS application icon for Kuizer, a developer disk cleanup utility. Direction: Workshop. A single beautiful compact hand brush sweeps diagonally across a deep burnt-orange and terracotta ceramic rounded-square tile. Brush has a warm ivory satin ceramic sculptural handle, brushed aluminium ferrule with fine horizontal machining, dense precisely individually rendered soft pale peach bristles with a gently curved sweep, restrained tiny dust flecks at bottom right. Visually clear cleaning tool, not a paintbrush or pencil. Strong generous simple silhouette legible at small size, fantastically detailed at large size. Rich amber orange bevel, subtle tactile microtexture, realistic occlusion and soft contact shadows, top left studio highlights. Front view, tiny amount of isometric depth. Design-led premium desktop app icon, not generic cartoon clip art. Tile occupies 76 percent of 1024x1024 square canvas with clear margin. No text, no watermark, no additional icons, no scenery. Isolated transparent background. Reference images are style and craftsmanship references only, do not replicate their subjects.

Create a single premium highly detailed macOS application icon for Kuizer, a developer utility that frees disk space. Concept: Aperture. A beautiful dimensional iridescent machined aluminium disk with a circular central aperture, a precise quarter wedge lifted slightly out of the upper right of the disk to evoke space being reclaimed. A dark midnight-indigo rounded-square tile holds the disk. Disk is strongly circular with radial microscopic brushed metal grooves, refracting subdued violet, electric blue, silver and faint rose. Lifted wedge has a clear thickness and sharply machined yet gently beveled edges, with soft shadow visible in the gap beneath. The disk remains the single simple memorable symbol, not a gear, not a camera lens, not pie chart infographic. Premium tactile metal and deep indigo satin glass tile, layered tile rim, subtle rim light, physical studio lighting from top left, polished-but-restrained spectral highlights. Front view with small dimensional tilt. Icon fully visible, centered in 1024x1024 square, fills 76 percent canvas, 12 percent transparent margin. Truly transparent background outside rounded square. No typography, no watermark, no scenery, no extra marks. Provided images are craftsmanship references only, do not copy their shapes or subjects.

Create one refined hybrid of the two attached Kuizer app icon concepts. The first reference supplies the clear rounded lowercase k silhouette; the second supplies the burnt orange glazed ceramic tile, ivory ceramic cleaning brush, brushed aluminium, incredibly fine individual bristles, tactile microtexture and studio lighting. Concept name: Workshop K. Make a single unmistakable lowercase k as an actual sculpted cleaning tool. The left vertical stem and the upper-right diagonal arm are softly rounded warm ivory ceramic, joined in a graceful K construction. The lower-right diagonal arm becomes a short elegant brush: a precise brushed aluminium collar at the letter's central joint and dense ivory-peach bristles fanning gently downward and to the right. Bristles must clearly continue the lower diagonal stroke of the k so the silhouette reads as a K first, cleaning brush second. Do not put a separate brush over a letter. Do not add a separate letter beside a brush. Keep the monogram bold, balanced and beautifully readable at dock size. Background tile is the same rich burnt-orange and terracotta ceramic squircle as the second reference with rounded bevels, fine glaze texture, amber rim highlights and soft realistic contact shadows. Restrained few dust motes by bristle tip only. Premium dimensional macOS icon craftsmanship, physically plausible upper-left studio lighting, sophisticated subtle sheen. Front view with very slight depth, consistent with both reference icons. Entire rounded-square tile centered and fully visible with 10 percent transparent margin on all sides, square high-resolution canvas. No wordmark, no additional letters, no watermark, no scenery. Preserve genuine alpha transparency outside the tile.

Refine the attached Kuizer Workshop K icon to be a LITTLE MORE ABSTRACT while preserving the rich burnt-orange glazed ceramic rounded-square tile, warm ivory foreground, detailed premium 3D materials, bevel quality, front-view composition and upper-left lighting. Replace the literal brush-shaped letter with a sophisticated abstract K monogram made from sculpted ivory forms. A softly rounded vertical stem and tapered upper diagonal meet a lower diagonal that curves outward into a broad graceful sweep. This lower sweep has just THREE broad smooth sculptural ivory fins separated by two delicate curved negative-space channels. They imply the motion of sweeping through their rhythm and direction, while still reading as the bottom arm of a K. All pieces are ceramic, with gently convex surfaces, exceptionally controlled bevel highlights, fine satin microtexture, soft contact shadows and tasteful spatial layering. Strong compact balanced silhouette, precise negative space, elegant icon design. Remove the literal brush handle, metal collar, every hair or bristle, all debris and dust. No broom, no paintbrush, no feathers, no illustrated cleaning object. Retain a recognizable K but reduce literal storytelling: a clean sculptural symbol that subtly suggests clearing space. Keep the warm dimensional craftsmanship of the original; do not flatten into generic vector clip art. No extra symbols, text or watermark. Entire icon centered, fully visible, consistent 10 percent transparent margin on square high-resolution canvas. Preserve genuine alpha transparency outside the orange tile.

Design a completely fresh premium desktop app icon for Kuizer. Concept: Unfold. A singular sculptural folded ribbon, made of thick pearlescent satin glass, suspended above a deep midnight petrol-blue rounded-square tile. The ribbon bends into an asymmetric open diamond loop with one corner peeling outward and upward, like a tightly folded object releasing into space. Bold simple silhouette with a generous dark negative-space opening at its heart. Visually intriguing and ownable abstract geometry: three broad continuous surfaces, one precise fold, one soft flowing turn. Milky silver-white faces, icy mint translucent edges, a restrained lavender refracted underside. Sophisticated physical material detailing: finely frosted faces, jewel-like polished bevels, realistic thickness, delicate internal refraction, occlusion where surfaces overlap, beautifully controlled highlights. Deep blue tile has a satin anodized finish, soft generous rounded corners and subtle machined edge; no glowing rainbow border. Strong contrast between pale floating sculptural form and nearly black blue tile. World-class macOS app icon craft, thoughtful industrial product rendering, subtle front-on perspective, studio key light upper left with a narrow cool rim light. Keep graphic simple enough to recognize at 32 pixels, reward close inspection with fine material detail. No letters or monograms, no K, no brush or cleaning tools, no bristles, no dust, no orange, no disk, no pie-chart, no sparkle symbol, no recycling arrows. This must feel like an entirely new visual identity, calm, sculptural and enigmatic. One icon only, centered, square high resolution, entire icon visible with 10 percent transparent margin on all sides. Genuine transparent background outside the tile. No typography, no watermark, no surrounding scene.

Create a new Kuizer macOS application icon closely guided by the attached pencil.png reference's visual language and extraordinary craftsmanship. Study the actual reference: saturated cyan blue violet pink yellow luminous app tile, very thin inset white rounded-square border, faint precision construction circles and diagonal guide lines, two beautifully rendered physical tools crossing diagonally, one partly translucent with white wireframe outlines, black foreground object with ivory tip and specular reflections, objects extending beyond the tile perimeter. Bring those specific qualities into this new cleanup utility icon. Concept: Draft. Background rounded-square tile is luminous rich cobalt and cyan at lower right, violet at lower left, pale coral and golden yellow at the upper edge; rich but disciplined gradient, satin surface with extremely fine microtexture, real bevel thickness, subtle inner white border and low-opacity geometric construction arcs. Rear object runs upper left to lower right: a short chunky precision eraser with rounded coral rubber end, a fine brushed aluminium band, amber translucent body transitioning gradually into clear optical glass and delicate white outlined geometry at its lower tip. Make its shape unmistakably a compact beveled eraser rather than a long pencil. Foreground object runs bottom left to top right: slim black lacquer cleanup wand with soft cylindrical sides, restrained metal join, and a short porcelain-white rounded tip. Elegant asymmetrical X composition, top and bottom ends break the tile silhouette slightly as in the reference. One tiny four-point highlight next to the white tip. Beautiful studio highlights, physically convincing contact shadows, glass refraction, metal machining, fine material transitions. Sophisticated designed objects, not clip art or cartoons. Keep two objects and the geometry spacious and immediately legible, no scattered dust or debris. Do not include letters, K, words, text, captions, watermarks, logos from reference, or extra objects. Front-on view with just enough depth to feel tactile, entire composition visible with generous margin, square canvas. Genuine transparent background outside tile and objects. Reference is the quality, color, composition and material target, not an edit target; create a fresh icon.

Refine the attached colorful desktop icon into a distinct Kuizer cleanup icon. Keep the exceptional rainbow cyan blue violet coral tile, inset white frame, subtle construction arcs, material quality and delicate physical shadows. IMPORTANT COMPOSITION CHANGE: remove BOTH the long pencil and the long diagonal magic wand entirely. Replace their X composition with one central oversized short chunky rectangular precision eraser, tilted 35 degrees clockwise, running upper-left to lower-right. Its aspect ratio must be only 1.8:1, like a real block eraser, never a pencil. This eraser has a soft coral-pink rubber upper half with finely tactile microtexture and gently rounded corners, a thin brushed aluminium waist band, and a lower half that transitions through milky white to clear frosted optical glass at a broad flat beveled edge. The transparent half reveals the geometric lines of the tile underneath with physically convincing refraction. A short path directly behind the broad lower-right edge shows faint white construction lines gently fading away, suggesting erasing. No dust, no debris, no writing, no pointed tip. Slightly lifted, physically plausible soft contact shadow, tactile realistic 3D object, polished highlights and subtle color bounce. Add only one small precision four-point shine beside the clear edge. Bold compact recognizable silhouette, generous negative space around the eraser so the luminous background and fine technical linework can breathe. Let a small corner of the eraser break the white inset frame, but keep all geometry inside the outer tile. Preserve the original image's premium macOS icon rendering, color richness, bevels and depth. No letters, no K, no wordmark, no text, no watermark. Entire rounded-square tile centered, square high resolution, fully visible with at least 10 percent transparent margin, genuinely transparent outside tile.
